programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby…

programme.title: One More Chance / 別叫我"賭神"
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his son’s talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Caught in Time / 除暴
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Limbo / 智齒
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Cham's wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Measure in Love / 他年她日
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate.

programme.title: Silent Code / BBS鄉民的正義
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem...

programme.title: Back to the Past / 尋秦記
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: Possession Street / 邪Mall
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: Cold War 2 / 寒戰2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Lau’s wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.
